mapper.sql: SELECT o.*, p.name AS pet_name, p.pet_type AS pet_type, s.cover AS service_cover, sv.name AS servicer_name, u.nickname AS user_nickname, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_review r WHERE r.order_id = o.id) AS reviewed FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_pet p ON p.id = o.pet_id LEFT JOIN t_service s ON s.id = o.service_id LEFT JOIN t_servicer sv ON sv.id = o.servicer_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = o.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_no, request_id, request_hash, user_id, pet_id, service_id, servicer_id, service_name, service_price, amount, service_duration, contact_name, contact_phone, address, appoint_date, time_slot, appointment_start, appointment_end, status, remark, create_time, expire_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, #{userId}, #{petId}, #{serviceId}, #{servicerId}, #{serviceName}, #{servicePrice}, #{amount}, #{serviceDuration}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{address}, #{appointDate}, #{timeSlot}, #{appointmentStart}, #{appointmentEnd}, #{status}, IFNULL(#{remark}, ''), NOW(), #{expireTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, request_hash FROM t_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, request_id, request_hash FROM t_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = 1, servicer_id = #{servicerId}, accept_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE t_order SET status = 2, finish_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE t_order SET status = 3, cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancel_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1)
UPDATE t_order SET status = 3, cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancel_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order WHERE pet_id = #{petId}
SELECT * FROM t_order WHERE status = 0 AND expire_time <= NOW() ORDER BY expire_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= #{todayStart} THEN 1 END) AS todayOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= #{todayStart} AND o.status = 2 THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayRevenue, COUNT(*) AS totalOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 2 THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalRevenue, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 0 THEN 1 END) AS pendingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user u WHERE u.role = 0) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_service s WHERE s.status = 1) AS onSaleServiceCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_review r) AS totalReview, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_review r WHERE r.rating >= 4) AS goodReview, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2), 0) FROM t_review r) AS avgRating FROM t_order o

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, #{dateFormat}) AS label, COUNT(CASE WHEN status <> 3 THEN 1 END) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue FROM t_order WHERE create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC

SELECT o.service_id AS serviceId, COALESCE(MAX(s.name), MAX(o.service_name)) AS serviceName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 2 THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_service s ON s.id = o.service_id WHERE o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.status <> 3 GROUP BY o.service_id ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
